title: 86. Payment of Pension at Treasury
html:
Form No. 86

Add the following Form as Form no. 86 after the Form no. 85

Form No. 86 Registered

..........Treasury

No..........

To,

Sri/Srimati/Kumari

..........

..........

..........

Subject :—Payment of Pension at Treasury

SIR/MADAM,

Your pension papers including pensioner’s half of Pension Payment Order have been received in this treasury. You are requested to call urgently at this treasury for personal identification and bring with you the following document on any working day in between ..........................to ........................

1. Your personal copy of the letter issued by the Accountant-General forwarding your Pension/Gratuity Payment Order to this treasury. Your copy of the order of sanction of pension endorsed to you.

2. Certificate of non-employment in any establishment/organisation.

3. In the case of deceased Government servant certificate of non-remarriage of widow / widower or of non-marriage by daughters.

4.

5.

6.

7. Your photograph has not been received along with your pension Payment Order, you are requested to bring with you a joint passport size photograph of yourself and your spouse.

Yours faithfully,

Treasury Officer-/

Senior Treasury Officer.

(C. S. no. 81, dated February 17, 1984)

[Vitta (Lekha) Anubhag-1, File no. 16(2)-82]
